nativeDesign: Keep the frozen full SHA/MD5/framing/header/feature/granularity/snapshot and immutable-file checks. Decoder EOF alone is insufficient.
requiredControls: Drift, truncation, unsupported precision/compression/features; failure never EOF.

nativeDesign: Native receipt counters before validation; positive signed64 IDs/version, strict typed order, duplicate rejection, all per-type/total quotas. Do not filter before validation.
requiredControls: Zero/negative/overflow/duplicate IDs, typed collisions, exact-cap/sentinel/partial counters.

nativeDesign: Same complete native timestamp/calendar/whole-second/UTC/shape/snapshot/visible rules as the frozen projector and validator; no rejection of valid epoch0 merely because a native Timestamp bool is false.
Exact native signed XY32 lattice and range, IEEE binary64 division in round-to-nearest, no fast-math/rounding; compare bits to reference. Preserve original framing precision rejection.
requiredControls: Extrema, signs, zero, subprecision, roundtrip bits, source/index drift, invalid locations.

nativeDesign: Validate accessed UTF-8 fields exactly as native-to-Python conversion; reject duplicate tag keys. Same incremental native-view copy charges; preserve all raw keys/values, not user/uid fields that old projection never copied.
requiredControls: Invalid UTF-8, controls, quote/backslash, BMP/non-BMP, duplicate keys, copy limits.

nativeDesign: Count exact canonical ASCII-escaped string/key/ref/member/integer/timestamp syntax natively. For node floats use a proven32-byte upper bound per finite float; accept safely below cap, reject safely above the lower bound, send only ambiguous near-limit nodes to the frozen Python canonical-size check via a bounded integer-XY frame. No approximate reject or C++ float formatting substitute.
requiredControls: cap-1/cap/cap+1, Unicode escape sizes, float width/exponent/negative zero; reject if fallback unavailable or callback raises.

nativeDesign: Positive ordered way references (at least2); valid typed positive members/roles; retain unresolved outside references exactly.
requiredControls: Invalid/short/missing refs, typed collisions, unresolved restriction members, no silent missing-location ignore.

nativeDesign: Generic unchanged21 windows, crossing/outside-node closure and relevant restrictions; separate native audit geometry/membership; retained raw/output/occurrence/heap caps unchanged.
requiredControls: Omit all or individual primary roads/nodes/restrictions, extra hints, wrong membership/tags/output, distinct audit storage.

nativeDesign: Acquired-file SHA/immutable checks plus lossless per-pass semantic seals, counts and independently rebuilt block equality; selected canonical JSON/geometry hashes stay byte-identical to reference.
requiredControls: Unselected metadata drift, selected raw drift, EOF/count/semantic hash mismatch; diagnostic seal never called the old JSON hash.

nativeDesign: C ABI primitives/length-prefixed buffers only; exceptions caught, callback lifetimes fixed, callback errors stop. Same worker cgroup/time/storage/process ownership controls; no extra container resources during execution.
requiredControls: Wrong ABI/endianness/length, callback exception/GC, process timeout/OOM/partial files, unrelated cleanup refusal.
